articles.title: Figuring out where cosmic neutrinos come from is tricky—radio telescopes could help find 'ghost particles' origin
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: Neutrinos are funny little particles that weigh almost nothing, making them one of the universe's most elusive building blocks. They can come from objects as mundane as bananas and as exotic as supernovas—the exploding death throes of massive stars. Most neutrinos stream through space and pass through the Earth without interacting with anything.

articles.title: The asteroid killed the dinosaurs. Why did crocodiles survive?
articles.summary: Scientists may have solved a 66-million-year-old mystery: how crocodiles survived the asteroid that wiped out the dinosaurs. A sweeping analysis of fossils and ancient climates suggests that their preference for warm environments placed them in tropical refuges that remained habitable even after the catastrophic impact.
